execution.holding: independent positions for1/3/5completed sessions after entry
execution.model_refit_boundary: one continuous account; retain holdings, reserved orders, due exits and settlement across annual refits
execution.cash: settled only; whole shares; no margin
execution.qualification: finite projections, positive projected exit notional and U>0
execution.ranking: stable alphabetical ties; static3setup percentile average; conditional U/N or U; recompute quantities/cost utility after reservations
execution.fill: quantity only decreases; original forecast utility recheck at fill price; simulated contingent-fill convention, no fill-time reranking
execution.stop: no research30%account halt; drawdowns assessed for qualification

proportional.rounding: no monetary rounding for proportional friction
proportional.order_assumption: one order per side per day; no multiday fills or promotion

recurring account or subscription charges and applicable taxes

actual spread, market impact and slippage beyond declared friction

treatment.calibration_samples: all original finite paired purged calibration rows, unweighted; no resampling or filtering
treatment.zero_variance: s=0 for exactly constant predictions; underflowed variance of nonconstant predictions is an explicit failure
treatment.downside: original corrected float64 downside bytes unchanged
treatment.invalid_calibration: fail and preserve attempt; no alternate model, row substitution or silent block drop
treatment.unavailable_test_forecasts: NaN remains unavailable, infinity invalid; original capture has no unavailable candidate predictions
treatment.thresholds: original positive net utility only; no cutoff changes or return clipping
treatment.comparison: each new account paired to original conditional_net_dollars same hold/cost; include failure and all-cash paths
treatment.model_fitting: none; only calibration coefficients computed from saved original pairs
treatment.ordering: positive slope preserves return ordering, but combined return/downside utility ordering can change

runtime_reuse.account_engine: original run_study.evaluate_account with output ROOT rebound to new study and save rebound to frontier.historical_lab._save only; no change to scientific functions
runtime_reuse.forecast_assembly: original assemble_forecasts over new transformed block NPZs
runtime_reuse.candidate_pool: rebuild original frozen context; exact daily counts and independent full row identities verified
runtime_reuse.statistics: original account_readout, plus independent ledger/forecast and full-calibration Decimal checks

outcome_plan.primary: paired net equity/expectancy and drawdown at unchanged fees; retain exposure, activity, all-cash and failure denominators
outcome_plan.secondary: weekly/monthly/yearly consistency, concentration and forecast return MSE on matched original observations
outcome_plan.decision: MSE improvement or abstention alone is not profitability; bounded calibration repair cannot supply a new return-ranking signal

original_inputs_scope: 4,434 eligible US-listed equity instruments including CEFs, ADRs and REITs; no retrospective scope cleaning
